variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.body: A party has a new leader in {colony}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Leadership changes hands
variants.body: Leadership of a political party has changed in the colony. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A new name at the head of the party
variants.body: A new leader is now at the head of a party in {colony}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
